caveats: Ground truth is the proofread 3D reprojected into each camera, so its own reconstruction error is folded into these numbers; they measure prediction-vs-proofread agreement, not absolute 2D accuracy.
Frames are uniformly strided, never selected.
Identity is matched per frame per camera by mean keypoint distance; a session where the predictor swapped animals for a long stretch will show that as error rather than as a swap.
`difficulty` is the corpus's own hand-assigned rating, not derived.
